allocation_complete.reason: No allocates; scored max as the guide prescribes.

completeness.reason: For REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER only cell limits are provided; nothing commits the BMS to a permitted charging power that supports the required minimum average power (same open point as BB_CHARGE_LIMITS).
completeness.suggestion: Add a permitted charging power published by the BMS once the BMS team provides the interface requirement.

consistency.reason: Reconciled with SUB_VCU and SUB_CHG: the BMS supplies values and contactor actions, they apply them.

design_clarity.reason: Concrete choices: the published signals/commands listed, and an external product whose released needs are imported per chemistry at release 0.1.0.

implementability.reason: Bounded: an external product at a pinned release, selected by chemistry.

interface_only.reason: No allocates; scored max as the guide prescribes.

no_value_copy.reason: Names signals only, no BMS limit, threshold or timing.

parent_fit.reason: Names the BMS contribution to each covered requirement: state of charge (energy display), permitted discharge power (traction limit), isolation fault and main contactors (HV shutdown), cell limits for charging (charging power).

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by if var.powertrain.type == 'bev'; every covered requirement is bev-gated or ungated.
